scientific_limitations_and_integrity.computational_limits: No finite experiment is used as proof of the infinite-time limit.
limitations: Only the specified realization and explicit sufficient smallness conditions are covered.
No claim is made for arbitrary defective closed-loop matrices, nonlinear plants, noisy measurements, or perturbed triggers.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.proof_basis: Self-contained analytic proof using uniform trigger-root bounds, projective recurrence, and the exact threshold equation on the limiting eigendirection.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Two-dimensional zero-order-hold plant with defective Hurwitz Jordan feedback and Euclidean relative-error trigger.

title: Exact limiting event interval for a defective Jordan feedback pair
